question: Does ambient isospectrality of the 19-dimensional active moduli immediately provide an admissible programme equivalence?

construction.sample: one deterministic simultaneous random point on S^3 x U(3) x S^3 x U(2)
construction.method: Use SVDs of the canonical and transformed 92x92 off-diagonal vacuum blocks to construct left/right unitary factors and assemble a grading-block-diagonal U(184) conjugator.
construction.warning: Degenerate singular values make the conjugator non-unique; this construction tests one generic witness, not existence of an optimized admissible witness.

interpretation.positive: An explicit unitary conjugator exists numerically and can be chosen to commute exactly with the particle/antiparticle grading.
interpretation.negative: The generic SVD witness is highly nonlocal across the 16 carrier blocks and does not satisfy the simplest bottom=conjugate(top) real-structure relation.
interpretation.conclusion: Ambient isospectrality does not by itself establish that the 19 moduli are admissible gauge or representation-basis redundancies.
interpretation.nonNoGo: Because of large singular-value degeneracies, another conjugator within the stabilizer freedom may satisfy additional structural constraints; this remains an existence problem.

nextProblem.formulation: Solve a constrained Procrustes/intertwiner problem inside degenerate singular subspaces, imposing carrier-block locality, grading, real structure, and algebra-normalizer conditions.

outcomes.success: quotient some or all of the 19-dimensional family as admissible equivalence
outcomes.failure: retain the corresponding directions as physical moduli needing orientation-locking dynamics

falsifiers: An explicit structure-preserving block-local conjugator for the same transformed vacuum would show the generic SVD witness was merely a poor choice.
A lower bound excluding all block-local conjugators below nonzero residual would establish a genuine admissibility obstruction.
A corrected real-structure matrix differing from the naive half-swap may alter the reported reality residual and must be audited before any no-go claim.
